ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid System Vulnerabilities
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the recurring vulnerabilities in the Minnesota Medicaid system, including billing issues and lack of safeguards
questions: What are the root causes of the vulnerabilities?
How much money has been lost due to these vulnerabilities?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose significant flaws in the state's healthcare system and potentially lead to reforms and improved safeguards.
